An unidentified '''planet''' located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] was the point of origin from which the [[Storm-hair]] [[Species/Legends|species]] emerged. [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and his [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], were Storm-hairs, and they destroyed dozens of other species and worlds until Esva himself was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in [[8 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> by the [[Empire of the Hand]]'s [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] on the Unknown Regions planet [[Quethold]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was mentioned in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
